feedback: If orientation is confusing, return to the 2D cross-section where the loop direction is clearer.
Reinforce that in convection the circulating fluid carries the energy with it; this is much faster than energy passing slowly through still fluid by conduction.
activities.intendedInsight: Convection has a genuinely spatial circulating loop and radiation spreads outward in space; seeing this at room scale can make the circulation and spread feel natural.
learnerActions: Explore a room-scale convection loop you can orbit, following warmed, less-dense fluid rising and cooler fluid sinking.
Watch radiant infrared spreading outward from a source through space.
Compare this spatial view with the 2D cross-section and describe what each makes clearer.
activities.title: Spatial convection loop and radiant spread
